title: Disable Logging Events to the Windows Application Log

facts.text: Server events logged to Application and Services Logs; Windows Application log logging can be disabled
Do not disable Windows Application log if using System Center Operations Manager for monitoring
Open administration tool, select server, edit instance, and clear Enable Event Logging to Windows Application Log
Restart server instance for changes to take effect
Alternatively, edit CustomSettings.config file and set EnableApplicationChannelLog to false, then restart
